scope: Independent read-only review of first-right.prompt clarification and minimum derived-artifact adoption; no builders, product imports, native calls, archive regeneration or Git writes.
finding: Accept the single prompt clarification. JSON-only adoption would leave the actual standalone lab Download course consumer stale.

prompt.old: For that same fair walk starting at 1, what is the probability of first reaching endpoint 3 at step 2?
prompt.proposed: For a fair walk on states 0..3 starting at 1, what is the probability of first reaching endpoint 3 at step 2?

preserved_answer.reason: Only the two right steps 1→2→3 arrive first at endpoint 3 on step 2; fair independent steps give (1/2)(1/2)=1/4.

minimum_adoption.action: Apply exactly the one prompt replacement; no other byte or field change.
Regenerate with the unchanged tools/build-absorbing-walk.mjs. It embeds complete course UTF-8 as base64 and the actual download handler serves those embedded bytes.

Produce an explicitly identified successor delivery package. Its course and lab members must contain the corrected source and regenerated output, and internal MANIFEST.json must update exactly their size/hash records. Preserve the previous archive as historical custody.

unchanged.remaining_source: Model, UI, template, deck parser and all unrelated fields and course items stay unchanged.
unchanged.maintained_tests: tests/absorbing-walk-course.test.mjs dynamically compares embedded bytes with current source; tools/check-absorbing-walk-browser.mjs compares actual downloads with current source. Neither contains the old prompt, old course hash or old 9418-byte size as a fixed expectation. No test-source change is required by this correction.

manifest.originalCommit_interpretation: The original learner identity stays exact; any new owner source commit and successor archive identity belong in an additive correction/adoption record.
manifest.custody: The earlier evidence/portable/MANIFEST.json and archived downloads/receipts describe the old delivery; do not edit or relabel them. Export any successor member manifest separately and bind it to the successor archive.

static_derivation.guide_context: The guide already states N=3, start i=1, p=q=1/2, and step-2 first-right probability 1/4. Neither old nor proposed prompt occurs in the guide.

remaining_owner_action: Within the existing owner's admitted route, regenerate the lab and package and bind the resulting course/download/member manifest to the new source and receipt. This review makes no claim that the corrected source or artifacts have been built, run, downloaded, adopted or integrated.
limits: The ZIP producer package-r1.py was not read or run. The exact maintained lab builder and exact package manifest establish the minimum dependency set, not archive reproducibility or fresh archive metadata.

outcome: No blocking content issue in the one-prompt replacement; derived lab/package refresh is required for actual recipient adoption.
